method.design: Repair-policy-only comparison: 8 paired seeds × 2 player policies × 2 repair rules = 32 campaigns. Every dependency and the current AI are identical. The perFleet variant substitutes only the automatic repair block with the exact Stage9 feb7894 formula. Both variants retain the split command; neither automated policy issues split commands. This is not a full Stage9-vs-Stage10 comparison.
method.repairs: perFleet grants each friendly fleet 4 hull, or 8 at a shipyard, plus Forge repair. colonyPool shares that same capacity at each owned unblocked colony in proportion to missing hull. Blockade rules and paid emergency repair are unchanged.
method.observer: Identical optional read-only observers sample hull immediately before and after only the passive-repair phase, after AI, income, construction and discovery processing. Observer results are never supplied to an AI. At cycles20/40/60, an instrumented step is compared with an unmodified engine step, and JSON-reloaded versus uninterrupted steps are compared byte-for-byte after serialization.
method.validity: Every initial state and every attempted completed round checks validateSave and finite nonnegative credits/minerals/science/orders for all four factions. checkedCycles counts successful turn increments; a campaign may finish during AI actions before incrementing or reaching repair.
method.denominators: Outcomes/finish distributions have8 campaigns per policy/repair variant. Passive technology/beacon/alignment timing has24 candidate rival empires per variant; balanced timing has8 candidate player empires. Timing medians include only achieved milestones and report their counts. An even median is the mean of the middle pair.
method.repairMetrics: hull sums actual positive fleet HP gains solely during passive repair; fleetCycles counts fleets receiving positive repair in a phase; colonyCycles counts owned colonies repairing at least one fleet in a phase. meanHullPerRepairingColonyCycle divides hull by colonyCycles. colonyCyclesAboveNewPool counts phases exceeding that colony’s shared4/8+Forge capacity by more than1e-9; hullAboveNewPool sums that excess. peakColocatedDamagedFleets counts damaged friendly fleets at one owned colony before passive repair, including blockaded colonies.
method.limitations: Eight fixed seeds and scripted policies are a regression/balance probe, not estimates of human win rates. The balanced player uses the same AI as rivals. Neither policy deliberately fragments fleets; the split/remerge anti-healing invariant is covered separately by unit and independent numerical tests. Outcomes can diverge after any combat/RNG consequence of the repair change; total repaired hull also depends on how much damage occurs and how long each campaign lasts.

passive.description: The player issues no commands; three rival empires use the unchanged current AI.

balanced.description: The player selects the first available technology in the stated mixed priority when idle, then uses the same current AI for expansion, economy, fleet control and alignment. Ordinary costs/orders apply; no grants.
